correctness.rationale: The corrected linearization follows by direct differentiation; an explicit nonconstant-c21 example distinguishes it from the source formula. The degree-parity criterion follows from a complete leading-order analysis at infinity combined with Wu--Hong Theorem 4.20.

originality.rationale: To the best of our knowledge, no public correction of arXiv:2609.18184v1 or prior application of this degree-parity obstruction to its generalized Virasoro modules was found. Classical Riccati and valuation techniques are treated as prior art.

value.rationale: The correction repairs a generally invalid computational reduction for nonconstant c21, while the parity theorem supplies a reusable closed-form irreducibility test and extends the paper's single degree-comparison example to a broad family.
